approved_source_corrections.note: User-approved Set projection: return distinct BookCopy object identities from the selected user's reservations, including closed reservation records. Do not merge different objects by equal attributes or add an open-reservation filter. Existing source preconditions and return type are preserved; executable representation and Oracle alignment remain separate checks.

User-approved Set result: return distinct BookCopy object identities from the selected user's unreturned Loans with fee > 0. Multiple qualifying Loans may share one returned copy; equal attribute values do not merge different objects. Existing filters and return type are preserved. Executable representation and Oracle alignment remain separate checks.

User-approved state timing: select users with positive days at operation entry, decrement once, and restore previously SUSPEND users only at the post-decrement zero-day boundary with no overdue fee. Retain suspension with outstanding fees; leave initially zero-day users unchanged. Executable representation and Oracle alignment remain separate checks.

User-approved alias-aware stock semantics: for each Item, add the quantities of all this order's entries referring to that object to its operation-entry stock. Distinct entries count separately; different Items are accumulated independently. Executable representation and Oracle alignment remain separate checks.

User-approved collection semantics: every sales line contributes its subtotal, including equal amounts on distinct lines. Replace Sale.Amount with the total, use zero for an empty sale, mark payment-ready and return the numeric total. Executable representation and Oracle alignment remain separate checks.

User-approved source correction: add every entry subtotal to the operation-entry amount, including equal subtotals on distinct entries; empty orders preserve the initial amount. Executable representation and full Oracle alignment remain separate checks.
User-approved variable-target correction: store newly created d, not absent lookup result dev. Original RM2PT snapshot remains unchanged; this is a laboratory-adjudicated source correction.

approved_source_mappings.note: User-approved source service alias: preserve both use-case samples and runtime service names, but link them to the same active original ListBookHistory operation. No business clauses are changed; the views are not independent original sources.
